en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a powerful river with rapids and waterfalls cascading through a rocky gorge. On the left is a steep, forested cliff with a narrow path along the rocks; on the right are man‑made stone structures and an industrial building near the falls, likely related to waterworks or hydroelectric power. In the distance a dam or bridge crosses the river. Printed captions appear at the bottom of the image.
